```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Public authorities must regain control of their correctional institutions, as prisons cannot become ethnic or racial battlegrounds.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Persons jailed for whatever cause should be protected against cruel or degrading treatment by other inmates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The institution of family-friendly policies may curtail prison violence and reduce the rate of recidivism, thus reducing the enormous fiscal and social costs of incarceration.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Breaking the cycle of crime begins with the children of those who are prisoners.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The children of prisoners, deprived of a parent through no fault of their own, should be a special concern of schools, social services, and religious institutions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Reagan's Task Force on Victims of Crime called the neglect of crime victims a \"national disgrace\" thirty years ago.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Reagan's Task Force on Victims of Crime proposed a Constitutional amendment to secure the formal rights of crime victims thirty years ago.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Despite some progress, the need for national action still persists in the unacceptable treatment of innocent victims.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The States should make it a bipartisan priority to protect the rights of crime victims.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Crime victims should be assured of access to social and legal services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Congress should make the federal courts a model in protecting the rights of crime victims for the rest of the country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
